theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + 1 + k))) (ξ : MultiVector (n + 1 + k) (n + 1)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ∃ (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) ∧ (∀ y : Euclid (n + 1 + k), ∃ v w, y = ι v + ι' w) ∧ Set.range ι = (Q : Set (Euclid (n + 1 + k))) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (n + 1), ξ α = α (fun j => ι (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))
